hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Find the smallest contiguous segment whose cumulative bitwise or meets or exceeds k.

hints.title: Window Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain an array tracking the frequency of set bits across the active segment to allow additions and removals in constant time.

hints.title: Shrinking the Range
hints.text: Expand the right pointer while adding element bits. While the current bitwise value is at least k, record length and remove left elements.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Each element is added and removed at most once using 32 bit counters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops evaluate O(n^2) subarrays with repeated bitwise calculations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using 32 integer counters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bit counters to make bitwise or reversible in a sliding window.
